basePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a polished high-resolution 1800 x 1200 landscape product design image for POKI, a Windows desktop AI companion. Treat reference images as visual guidance, not text to copy. Theme: Violet Air. Milky white canvas #F8F9FD, white panels, pale lilac #F0EEFF selections, primary violet #7565E8, deep ink #292744, muted slate #7D8197, whisper borders #E8EAF3, tiny soft shadows. Inspired by the supplied light dashboard's refined restraint, modular cards, slim sidebar and generous space. Crisp readable Segoe UI/Inter-like typography, 18px panel radius, 10px controls, uniform fine-line icons, strong hierarchy, ample breathing room. A real native desktop application design, front-facing, perfectly flat, no browser chrome, no perspective, no laptop or device mockup. One main app window fills 94% of image on a pale gray backdrop, thin top titlebar with minimize/maximize/close. Consistent left sidebar: blue tilted two-eye robot mark + 'poki' at top; navigation in exact order Shortcuts, Chat, Reminders, Email, Usage, Settings; footer local circular avatar 'JD' with name 'Jamie Doe'. Keep the supplied robot silhouette and proportions without distortions, clean blue. All names, messages and statistics are illustrative demo data. Do not invent live ChatGPT quota, credentials, payment or billing prompts. Avoid dark themes, heavy gradients, neon, glass blobs, medical content, unreadably dense type, irrelevant KPI charts. Render exact concise English labels cleanly.

screens.title: Floating robot & one-touch launcher
screens.detail: OVERRIDE full-window composition: a beautiful three-step desktop interaction design board on a pale lavender background, labeled '01 At rest', '02 One click', '03 Full workspace'. Large generous first two states occupy most of canvas. State 01 only the original tilted blue robot head hovering unobtrusively on an otherwise calm desktop, no white disk behind robot; small caption 'Your assistant, always nearby'. State 02 a 360px-wide rounded white popup beside the same robot: header small robot + poki wordmark on left and identically sized line-drawn hamburger and X on right. Below ONLY 8 recognizable app icons in a 4x2 grid, no app names, no add button, no explanatory text inside popup. Icons VS Code, Chrome, File Explorer, Calculator, Notion, Spotify, Downloads, Teams. Optional single tiny floating tooltip 'VS Code' near hovered icon, no permanent label. State 03 small faithful full-workspace preview as in reference. Elegant thin connector arrows outside panels map robot click -> launcher and hamburger click -> full app. Under stage03 caption 'Manage apps in Settings'. No dropdown menu from hamburger. Keep screens straight, not tilted.

screens.title: Chat & assistant actions
screens.detail: Selected sidebar Chat. Main header 'A little help, a clearer day.' with New chat button. A narrow conversation list within main content left titled 'Recent chats' and three items Study plan (selected), Email draft, Project ideas. Main conversation white card: user's right-aligned pale lavender bubble 'Help me plan a focused evening of studying.' Assistant robot avatar response 'Let’s keep it simple.' followed by three airy rows: '7:00 PM — Review your notes', '7:30 PM — Practise one topic', '8:15 PM — Take a break'. A small proposed reminder action card 'Remind me at 7:00 PM' with violet 'Create reminder' and secondary Edit. Bottom fixed rounded composer 'Ask POKI anything…', attach icon, microphone outline, violet circular arrow send button. Footer tiny 'Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line'. Header model chip 'Your configured model'. Slim right rail titled 'Quick actions' with Rewrite text, Summarize, Draft an email, Create reminder, all quiet line icons. No billing or real token metrics. Content concise, clear and beautiful.

Main left 2/3 white card title 'Your reminders' with Today / Upcoming / Completed tabs (Today active). Three polished list rows with checkbox, description, recurrence pill, due time and ellipsis: Review study notes, 7:00 PM, Once; Take a screen break, 8:15 PM, Daily; Check attendance, Mon 9:00 AM, Weekly. Each row full whitespace. A subdued completed row 'Back up project files' checked. Minimal genuine schedule visual, no arbitrary metrics. Bottom legend 'Times shown in your local timezone'.

screens.title: Add / edit reminder
screens.detail: Selected sidebar Reminders visible behind a lightly dimmed blurred reminders page. Center a large white rounded modal titled 'A reminder for later' with small line bell, subtitle 'Set it once. POKI will keep track.' Clear form: Description 'Review study notes'; Date '11 Nov 2026' with calendar icon; Time '7:00 PM' with clock icon side-by-side; Repeat segmented choices Once / Daily / Weekly with Weekly selected; days row M T W T F S S with Wed selected; Notifications toggle on. Quiet summary strip 'Every Wednesday at 7:00 PM'. Footer Cancel secondary and violet 'Save reminder'. Top-right equal-size X. A small separate inset bottom-right depicts a reminder toast 'Time to review your notes' with Snooze 10 min and Mark done. Keep main modal text large and sparse, design focused and usable.

screens.title: Email inbox & account switching
screens.detail: Selected sidebar Email. Header 'Your inbox, in focus.' Sender chip with G icon 'jamie@example.com' and chevron; primary Compose. Main content three neat areas: slim mailbox filter Inbox / Unread / Drafts / Sent, middle message list with search 'Search your email', right selected message reading pane. 3 demo messages: Professor Lee 'Project check-in' 10:42 AM selected unread; Campus team 'This week on campus' Yesterday; Alex Morgan 'Design review' Yesterday. Reading pane 'Project check-in', Professor Lee, To jamie@example.com, text 'Hi Jamie, Could you share a short update on your project before Friday? Thank you, Professor Lee.' Toolbar Reply, Forward, Summarize thread. Below narrow lavender summary box 'A project update is requested before Friday.' A separate unobtrusive account dropdown is OPEN under sender chip, showing selected Gmail jamie@example.com, Outlook jamie@outlook.example, Add account, Manage accounts. No private real email data. All fonts readable; frame is one coherent app, no detached generic charts.

screens.title: Email composition & send approval
screens.detail:
Selected sidebar Email. Full main compose panel with heading 'Make every message count.' Sender Gmail chip jamie@example.com. Editable fields To 'professor@example.com', Subject 'Project update — Friday submission'. Main large email editor text 'Dear Professor Lee,

I’m making steady progress on the project and will send the completed update by Friday. Thank you for your guidance.

Best regards,
Jamie'. Small drafting controls Professional / Friendly / Shorter above editor. Footer Save draft, Preview and send primary. On the right a prominent white review card titled 'Review before sending' with recipient and subject repeated, concise body preview, soft violet info 'Nothing is sent without your approval.' Buttons Back to editing and violet 'Confirm send'. A discreet success toast below reads 'Email sent' with green check. The review is clearly a separate approval stage presented as a right panel. No automatic sending toggle on this screen. Careful alignment and low density.

screens.title: Manual ChatGPT usage tracker
screens.detail: Selected sidebar Usage. Header 'Know your remaining room.' Clearly prominent pale amber notice 'Live ChatGPT usage is unavailable' with body 'Track your usage manually. This is an estimate.' Main large white card with tasteful violet progress ring '40%' center and label 'Manual estimate'; visible counts '20 used / 50 entered limit'. This is fictional manually entered demo data, never live. Right card 'Update your estimate' fields Plan 'My plan', Used '20', Limit '50', Reset date '12 Nov 2026', Reset time '9:00 AM', primary Save estimate. Below two clean alert threshold cards 'Warning · 80%' and 'Critical · 95%' with enable switches on. Bottom info 'OpenAI API usage is separate from ChatGPT subscription usage.' Quiet external link 'Open ChatGPT usage ↗'. No invented automatic syncing or accurate quota claim. Very restrained premium design with ample white space.

screens.title: Settings — appearance & one-touch behavior
screens.detail: Selected main sidebar Settings. Header 'Make POKI feel like yours.' Subnavigation tabs within content: General (selected), Shortcuts, AI & voice, Accounts, Notifications, Privacy. Main left wide card 'One-touch access': dropdown 'Floating click opens' selected Shortcuts; slider 'Floating robot size' ranging 40–192 px current 96 px with numeric stepper; toggle 'Gentle floating motion' ON; toggle 'Always on top' ON; shortcut selector 'Ctrl + Alt + T'; startup toggle 'Launch when Windows starts' ON. Right tall preview card shows properly proportioned blue floating robot and small white icon-only launcher with hamburger and X. Bottom card 'Appearance' with Light chosen, Dark unselected, small violet accent swatch and subtle transparency slider. Small footer 'Changes saved' green dot. Sliders visible and manual, labels strong, no settings hidden in a tiny popover.

screens.title: Settings — manage app shortcuts
screens.detail: Selected main sidebar Settings; content tabs General, Shortcuts (selected), AI & voice, Accounts, Notifications, Privacy. Header 'Your favorite apps, one touch away.' Main wide white card list 'Saved shortcuts' with large app icons and names: VS Code, Chrome, File Explorer, Calculator, Spotify; each row reorder handle, local illustrative path, edit icon and remove icon. No giant unreadable paths. Right card 'Add a shortcut' with dotted file picker 'Choose an .exe or .lnk', Browse files button, Name field 'Design workspace', app icon preview, primary Add shortcut. This is management inside full settings workspace, never in small launcher. Keep restrained, uncluttered, aligned.

screens.title: Settings — notifications & privacy
screens.detail: Design board of TWO equally sized complete matching POKI settings windows side by side, each readable at this landscape resolution. Use compact same shell, minimal content. LEFT WINDOW Notifications selected under Settings, header 'Only the interruptions you choose.' Four rows: Reminders ON, Email updates ON, Usage alerts ON, Notification sounds OFF; quiet hours From 10:00 PM To 8:00 AM switch OFF; threshold fields Warning 80%, Critical 95%; small native toast preview 'Study session · 7:00 PM'. RIGHT WINDOW Privacy selected under Settings, header 'Your data, under your control.' Card 'Stored on this device' with Conversation history and Reminders. Buttons Clear chat history, Delete API key. Card 'Connected account permissions' with Gmail Read and send email / Manage access. Note 'API keys and tokens are encrypted for your Windows account.' Clear small confirmation panel 'Clear chat history?' 'This removes saved conversations on this device.' buttons Cancel / Clear history. No contact secrets, readable, spacious.

screens.detail: OVERRIDE full-window composition: a premium UI component/state board of SIX clearly separated white floating panels arranged 3 columns by 2 rows on the same pale lilac canvas, with title 'The small moments, considered.' and little subtitles outside each card. TOP LEFT 'Tray menu' beautiful native-style context menu with robot + poki header and entries Open POKI, New chat, Add reminder, Email assistant, Usage monitor, Settings, Pause notifications, Restart POKI, Exit, ample row spacing. TOP MIDDLE 'Empty launcher' compact rounded launcher matching image01 with robot wordmark, equal hamburger/X, simple empty state 'Your space for everyday apps' and 'Open Settings to add a shortcut', no add button. TOP RIGHT 'Connection issue' small account panel 'Sign-in couldn’t finish' 'Check your OAuth setup, then try again.' buttons Retry / Open settings. BOTTOM LEFT 'Reminder' toast 'Review study notes' 'Today · 7:00 PM' Snooze 10 min / Mark done. BOTTOM MIDDLE 'Safe action approval' panel 'Open this application?' 'Design workspace' 'C:\Apps\Design.exe' Cancel / Open app, clear file icon. BOTTOM RIGHT 'Assistant states' three tiny stacked tasteful status messages Thinking… with violet dots, Listening… with subtle waveform and Stop, and 'Email sent' green check. These six panels must be clearly separated, no overlap. Consistent typography and colors from reference.
